answer_1.quote: We focus on creating agents in LIGHT , a large-scale crowdsourced fantasy text-adventure game, consisting of rich textual worlds-locations, objects, and characters with personas, and quests-motivations for each character.
answer_1.outputs: dialogue utterances and action commands in a text-based game environment

answer_2.quote: We report the standard array of metrics: hits@10 and F1 ranking prediction score for retrieval models; and F1 (as a harmonic average of BLEU-1  and ROUGE-1 ) and perplexity for generative models.
